title: 机械凸轮档案几何001
instruction:
您是 Pinehollow Health Network 的机械工程师 Laila Fitzgerald，正在为一家小型印刷博物馆准备替换零件图纸，该博物馆正在使用 Cormac Schuyler 的 1961 Brennerhoff & Sohn 平压印刷机。印刷机的压印凸轮破裂了，只有在替换件能够记录下来并归档在幸存制造商的图纸旁边时，博物馆才会接受该机器。 Heronbank Terminals 正在为我们切割零件，因此板材需要为机械师提供可用尺寸，同时与时期档案保持可识别的一致。准备工作时，请使用`archive_sheet_01.pdf`和`archive_sheet_02.pdf`中的两张存档图纸、`cam_measurements.xlsx`中的测量凸轮和轴记录、`museum_acceptance_note.docx`中的博物馆验收单以及`archive_convention_reference.pdf`中提供的图纸参考。创建一个名为 `replacement_impression_cam_drawing.xlsx` 的文件并将其写入工作目录的顶层。它将横向打印在A3纸上，放入套筒中，并搁置在原始纸张旁边；保持绘图在该物理尺寸下的可读性，并使视图、尺寸、注释、标题信息和第一角度约定与提供的材料一致。
图纸必须是可重复使用的工作表，而不是完整的检查记录：包括零件定义和加工信息，但将测量结果和批准/签名条目留空。登记员要求提供一个明确边界的地方，以便在不将周围的绘图推离对齐的情况下，可以写入后来的测量值或偏差，即使它比普通值长，并且要求简短的拾取指导，以便下一个工程师知道空白字段的含义，而无需指导接管纸张。请勿添加现代徽标、颜色品牌、额外视图、不受支持的容差或有关博物馆是否应接受媒体的建议。保留提供的档案的单位、行层次结构、字母字符、GD&T 之前的限制样式和第一角度读数。保持工作簿功能齐全且易于检查，绘图表作为唯一可打印的表。

---

上面提到的文件在`references/`中：

- `references/archive_sheet_01.pdf` — 第一张幸存的 Brennerhoff & Sohn 档案图显示了周期表约定、视图排列、字母、行层次结构、标题块语言和第一角度投影。
- `references/archive_sheet_02.pdf` — 第二张幸存的档案图纸，用于证实历史尺寸、限制符号、注释块处理和图纸比例。
- `references/cam_measurements.xlsx` — 裂纹凸轮、配合轴、键槽和更换零件包络线的完整且内部一致的测量记录。
- `references/museum_acceptance_note.docx` — 博物馆备案和受理要求，包括识别文字和在检查前必须保持空白的信息。
- `references/archive_convention_reference.pdf` — 参考摘录，定义了在比较完成的工作簿时要使用的可复制图纸几何形状、投影符号处理、线宽层次结构以及句点字母和限制约定。

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：
- `replacement_impression_cam_drawing.xlsx` — 单页、可打印的替换压印凸轮细节图，布局为 A3 风景档案样式图纸。 （工作簿必须恰好包含一张工作表和一张可打印的绘图表。；该表必须打印为一张A3横向页，适合一页宽和一页高。；绘图几何形状、尺寸、注释、标题信息和第一角度约定必须来自提供的参考。；测量结果和批准/签名字段必须保持完全空白。；该表必须包括有界的可扩展偏差或超出范围值的区域和简洁的拾取指南。；做不得添加徽标、颜色品牌、不支持的容差或建议。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

materials.text:
Museum intake and drawing filing note
Pinehollow Health Network is preparing a replacement impression cam for the 1961 Brennerhoff & Sohn platen press, model P-17, received from Cormac Schuyler. File the drawing beside the surviving maker sheets.
Use drawing number 61-CAM-017, initial revision A. The prepared-by field should identify Laila Fitzgerald, Mechanical Engineer. Material is to remain the source wording: steel. Units are millimetres.
The sheet is a working drawing. Leave inspection result, inspection date, approval/signature, and any deviation entry blank until the machined part is inspected.

rows:
1  ALL DIMENSIONS IN MILLIMETRES UNLESS OTHERWISE SHOWN.

3  DATUM A IS THE SHAFT AXIS; KEYWAY CENTRELINE IS 0° FROM DATUM A.
4  MATERIAL: STEEL. BREAK SHARP EDGES 0.50 (0.30 / 0.70).
5  PROFILE: BASE R34.00, NOSE R41.00, RISE 7.00; START 35° (34.5 / 35.5), END 145° (144.5 / 145.5).

PREPARED BY
Laila Fitzgerald, Mechanical Engineer
ARCHIVE COMPATIBLE LIMIT STYLE — NO GENERAL TOLERANCE

criteria.description: 提交的工作簿成功打开为有效的 XLSX 文件。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿包和工作表 XML。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用openpyxl以只读和普通模式打开；仅当包裹有效时才奖励。

original.criterion: The submitted workbook opens successfully as a valid XLSX file.
original.grader_hint: Open with openpyxl in read-only and normal modes; award only if the package is valid.

criteria.description: 该工作簿仅包含一张工作表。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查工作簿.工作表。

original.criterion: The workbook contains exactly one worksheet.
original.grader_hint: Inspect workbook.worksheets.

criteria.description: 工作表标题标识替换印模凸轮。
criteria.evidence: 可见的工作表标题或标题块文本。
criteria.grader_hint: 在渲染的图纸文本中搜索零件标识。

original.criterion: The worksheet title identifies the replacement impression cam.
original.evidence: Visible sheet title or title-block text.
original.grader_hint: Search rendered sheet text for the part identity.

criteria.description: 可打印绘图占据定义的A1:AV36绘图边界。
criteria.evidence: 打印区域并渲染使用的边界。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查print_area并确认渲染的绘图没有延伸到A1:AV36之外。

original.criterion: The printable drawing occupies the defined A1:AV36 drawing boundary.
original.evidence: Print area and rendered used boundary.
original.grader_hint: Inspect print_area and confirm the rendered drawing does not extend outside A1:AV36.

criteria.description: 打印纸张尺寸为A3。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据 A3 检查纸张尺寸。

original.criterion: The print paper size is A3.
original.grader_hint: Check paperSize against A3.

criteria.description: 打印方向为横向。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查page_setup.方向。

original.criterion: The print orientation is landscape.
original.grader_hint: Check page_setup.orientation.

criteria.description: 该纸张适合一页宽和一页高。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查 fitToWidth=1 和 fitToHeight=1 并启用 fitToPage。

original.criterion: The sheet is fitted to one page wide and one page tall.
original.grader_hint: Check fitToWidth=1 and fitToHeight=1 with fitToPage enabled.

criteria.description: 渲染后的工作表恰好是一页打印页。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿的 PDF 渲染。
criteria.grader_hint: 通过 LibreOffice 或等效的离线 Office 渲染器进行渲染并计数页面。

original.criterion: The rendered sheet is exactly one printed page.
original.grader_hint: Render through LibreOffice or an equivalent offline office renderer and count pages.

criteria.description: 外部绘图边框是围绕绘图边界的连续矩形。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查可打印工程图所有四个边的边框线。

original.criterion: The outer drawing border is a continuous rectangle around the drawing boundary.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the border lines at all four sides of the printable drawing.

criteria.description: 标题块占据定义的下六行带A31:AV36。
criteria.evidence: 渲染的工作表和单元格边框。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认标题栏以行 31 到 36 为界，并跨越绘图宽度。

original.criterion: The title block occupies the defined lower six-row band A31:AV36.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the title block is bounded by rows 31 through 36 and spans the drawing width.

criteria.description: 主绘图区域保留在标题块上方并且不与其重叠。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查视觉重叠或文本是否跨越行30/标题块边界。

original.criterion: The main drawing region remains above the title block and does not overlap it.
original.grader_hint: Check for visual overlap or text crossing the row-30/title-block boundary.

criteria.description: 主凸轮轮廓视图位于左上角的绘图区域中。
criteria.grader_hint: 通过凸轮轮廓和尺寸标注来识别轮廓视图。

original.criterion: The primary cam profile view is present in the upper-left drawing region.
original.grader_hint: Identify the profile view by its cam outline and dimension callouts.

criteria.description: 配合孔或轴轴线视图位于右上方绘图区域中。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认单独的视图传达轴与轴的关系。

original.criterion: The mating-hole or shaft-axis view is present in the upper-right drawing region.
original.grader_hint: Confirm a separate view communicates the shaft-axis relationship.

criteria.description: 剖面或细节视图传达键槽或配合特征，而不会与主视图冲突。
criteria.grader_hint: 找到细节并检查与主轮廓的分离。

original.criterion: A section or detail view communicates the keyway or mating feature without colliding with the primary view.
original.grader_hint: Locate the detail and check separation from the main profile.

criteria.description: 这些视图对凸轮和配合轴使用一致的中心线对齐。
criteria.evidence: 单元格边框/线条对象和渲染对齐。
criteria.grader_hint: 比较视图中的可见中心线和轴位置。

original.criterion: The views use consistent centerline alignment for the cam and mating axis.
original.evidence: Cell border/line objects and rendered alignment.
original.grader_hint: Compare the visible centerlines and axis positions across views.

criteria.description: 第一角度投影指示符存在于指定的投影符号区域中。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找传统的第一角符号，而不仅仅是“第一角”一词。

original.criterion: The first-angle projection indicator is present in the designated projection-symbol area.
original.grader_hint: Look for the conventional first-angle symbol, not merely the words first angle.

criteria.description: 投影指示器被标记或以其他方式明确地标识为第一角度。
criteria.evidence: 可见的符号和相邻的文本。
criteria.grader_hint: 当符号或标签不能被合理地解读为第三角度时授予奖项。

original.criterion: The projection indicator is labelled or otherwise unambiguously identified as first-angle.
original.grader_hint: Award when the symbol or label cannot reasonably be read as third-angle.

criteria.description: 线层次结构区分可见轮廓、隐藏细节和中心线。
criteria.evidence: 单元格边框、绘图线和渲染外观。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查每种线型的至少一个示例并比较粗细/样式。

original.criterion: The line hierarchy distinguishes visible outlines, hidden detail, and centerlines.
original.evidence: Cell borders, drawing lines, and rendered appearance.
original.grader_hint: Inspect at least one example of each line type and compare weight/style.

criteria.description: 中心线明显延伸到相关要素之外，而不是终止于相关要素内部。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查主圆或轴的轴线中心线。

original.criterion: Centerlines extend visibly beyond the relevant feature rather than ending inside it.
original.grader_hint: Check the main circular or shaft-axis centerlines.

criteria.description: 显示的隐藏功能使用独特的虚线约定。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认隐藏的边缘未表示为实线轮廓线。

original.criterion: Hidden features, where shown, use a distinct dashed convention.
original.grader_hint: Confirm hidden edges are not represented as solid outline lines.

criteria.description: 该图准确地说明了测量记录所建立的源单位系统。
criteria.grader_hint: 将所有单位参考与 cam_measurements.xlsx 进行比较。

original.criterion: The drawing states the source unit system exactly as established by the measurement record.
original.grader_hint: Compare all unit references with cam_measurements.xlsx.

criteria.description: 测量记录中每个所需的加工尺寸都会在相应的视图或注释中出现一次。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据测量表建立清单；不需要特定的小区位置。

original.criterion: Every required machined dimension from the measurement record appears once in an appropriate view or note.
original.grader_hint: Build a checklist from the measurement table; do not require a particular cell location.

criteria.description: 图中未省略任何所需的凸轮轮廓尺寸。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查所提供记录中列出的轮廓半径、偏移量和角度/位置值。

original.criterion: No required cam-profile dimension is omitted from the drawing.
original.grader_hint: Check profile radii, offsets, and angular/location values listed in the supplied record.

criteria.description: 图中未省略任何所需的轴、孔或键槽尺寸。
criteria.grader_hint: 将绘图与 cam_measurements.xlsx 中的配合特征行进行比较。

original.criterion: No required shaft, bore, or keyway dimension is omitted from the drawing.
original.grader_hint: Compare the drawing against the mating-feature rows in cam_measurements.xlsx.

criteria.description: 尺寸值与测量记录一致，没有不支持的舍入改变规定的限制。
criteria.evidence: 与源工作簿的数字比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用源精度比较标称值和限值。

original.criterion: Dimension values agree with the measurement record without unsupported rounding that changes the stated limit.
original.grader_hint: Compare nominal values and limits using the source precision.

criteria.description: 所有尺寸限制均以存档的 GD&T 之前限制样式再现。
criteria.evidence: 尺寸标签与两个存档 PDF 进行比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 当源使用成对限制或加/减表示法时，拒绝现代特征控制框架或替代的 GD&T。

original.criterion: All dimension limits are reproduced in the archive's pre-GD&T limit style.
original.evidence: Dimension labels compared with both archive PDFs.
original.grader_hint: Reject modern feature-control frames or substituted GD&T when the source uses paired limits or plus/minus notation.

criteria.description: 该图未引入所提供来源中不存在的一般公差。
criteria.grader_hint: 将每个一般公差声明与 archive_sheet_01.pdf 和 archive_sheet_02.pdf 进行比较。

original.criterion: The drawing does not introduce a general tolerance absent from the supplied sources.
original.grader_hint: Compare each general-tolerance statement with archive_sheet_01.pdf and archive_sheet_02.pdf.

criteria.description: 凸轮和轴的基准关系在视图和注释中一致地表述。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查无论标注尺寸的位置，是否由相同的参考特征控制。

original.criterion: The cam and shaft datum relationship is stated consistently in the views and notes.
original.grader_hint: Check that the same reference feature controls the location wherever it is dimensioned.

criteria.description: 键槽方向和位置在平面图/详细视图和测量记录之间一致。
criteria.grader_hint: 比较角度方向和位置尺寸。

original.criterion: The keyway orientation and location agree between the plan/detail views and the measurement record.
original.grader_hint: Compare angular orientation and positional dimensions.

criteria.description: 更换零件包络线仍保留在测量记录中规定的加工包络线内。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查整体范围和间隙值，而不仅仅是视觉比例。

original.criterion: The replacement-part envelope remains within the machining envelope stated in the measurement record.
original.grader_hint: Check overall extent and clearance values, not visual scale alone.

criteria.description: 标题栏将该部件标识为替换压印凸轮。
criteria.grader_hint: 搜索渲染的文本和单元格值以获取所需的零件标识。

original.criterion: The title block identifies the part as the replacement impression cam.
original.grader_hint: Search rendered text and cell values for the required part identity.

criteria.description: 标题栏包括博物馆注释提供的新闻标识。
criteria.evidence: 标题块文本与museum_acceptance_note.docx进行比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 要求提供媒体标识和型号措辞，仅允许无害的印刷变化。

original.criterion: The title block includes the press identification supplied by the museum note.
original.grader_hint: Require the supplied press identity and model wording, allowing only harmless typographic variation.

criteria.description: 标题栏包括博物馆注释所需的图号。
criteria.grader_hint: 与所提供注释中的确切图纸编号约定进行比较。

original.criterion: The title block includes the drawing number required by the museum note.
original.grader_hint: Compare against the exact drawing-number convention in the supplied note.

criteria.description: 标题栏包括起草者或负责工程师的字段标签。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要一个字段来进行负责任的准备，而不仅仅是一个未标记的名称。

original.criterion: The title block includes the drafter or responsible engineer field label.
original.grader_hint: Require a field for responsible preparation, not merely an unlabelled name.

criteria.description: 标题栏包括材料字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查材料名称是否与源记录一致。

original.criterion: The title block includes a material field.
original.grader_hint: Check for a material designation consistent with the source record.

criteria.description: 标题栏包括比例字段。
criteria.evidence: 标题栏标签和视图比例文本。
criteria.grader_hint: 要求刻度指示不会误导印刷品。

original.criterion: The title block includes a scale field.
original.evidence: Title-block labels and view scale text.
original.grader_hint: Require a scale indication that is not misleading for the printed sheet.

criteria.description: 标题块包括标识A3的图纸尺寸字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 在标题栏文本中搜索 A3 或存档等效的图纸大小符号。

original.criterion: The title block includes a sheet-size field identifying A3.
original.grader_hint: Search title-block text for A3 or the archive-equivalent sheet-size notation.

criteria.description: 标题栏包括修订字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要有明确标记的修订位置。

original.criterion: The title block includes a revision field.
original.grader_hint: Require a clearly labelled revision location.

criteria.description: 修订值显示为所提供的博物馆注释所标识的初始版本。
criteria.grader_hint: 将发行价值与博物馆纸币进行比较。

original.criterion: The revision value is present as the initial issue identified by the supplied museum note.
original.grader_hint: Compare the issue value with the museum note.

criteria.description: 测量结果字段存在且为空。
criteria.evidence: 单元格值和渲染的工作表。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查指定结果字段中是否有无/空字符串且没有公式。

original.criterion: The measurement-result field is present and empty.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the designated result field for None/empty string and no formula.

criteria.description: 检查日期字段存在且为空。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查空白字段而不是占位符日期。

original.criterion: The inspection date field is present and empty.

spec.professional_context: This is a period-compatible mechanical drawing for a one-off replacement part being machined and then filed as museum documentation. The downstream users are a machinist, a museum registrar, and a later engineer who must be able to read the sheet without reconstructing its conventions.
difficulty_sources: Reproduce a period drawing convention from two supplied archive sheets.
Translate a complete measurement record into a coherent, machinable replacement-part drawing.
Preserve first-angle layout, line hierarchy, note placement, and pre-GD&T limits.
Design a bounded out-of-range-value area and concise pickup guidance without compromising the drawing geometry.
Produce an editable, one-page A3 landscape workbook that renders correctly offline.

print.margins: archive-compatible narrow margins with visible border

required_geometry: One primary cam profile view in the upper-left region.
One mating shaft-axis view in the upper-right region.
One keyway or mating-feature detail view in the lower-right region.
A bounded notes block in the lower-left region.
A first-angle projection symbol in the upper-right corner region.
A distinct bounded deviation area with wrapped editable text capacity, kept empty.
A compact bounded pickup-guidance area, separate from the main views.
A six-row title block spanning the bottom of the sheet.

source_derivation.archive_sheet_01.pdf: Use for first-angle arrangement, border and title-block character, line hierarchy, note placement, and lettering.
source_derivation.archive_sheet_02.pdf: Use to corroborate period limit notation, dimension presentation, and view/detail conventions.
source_derivation.cam_measurements.xlsx: Use as the sole source for cam, bore, shaft, keyway, envelope, angular, and mating dimensions.
source_derivation.museum_acceptance_note.docx: Use for filing identity, drawing-number wording, blank inspection fields, and required museum documentation language.
source_derivation.archive_convention_reference.pdf: Use for exact reproducible sheet geometry, projection-symbol placement, and the controlled visual convention.

deterministic_rules: Every required dimension in the measurement record must appear in the appropriate view or notes.
Use the measurement-record units and precision.
Use the archive's pre-GD&T limit style and do not invent general tolerances.
Keep notes inside the bounded notes block.
Keep the deviation area and inspection fields empty.
Keep guidance concise and inside its bounded region.
Do not introduce logos, unsupported specifications, recommendations, or additional views.
behaviour_specification.out_of_range affordance: The deviation area must be a separate bordered merged/wrapped region with enough horizontal and vertical capacity for a longer handwritten or typed measurement and explanatory note. It must not alter adjacent view coordinates or title-block boundaries.
behaviour_specification.pickup_guidance: Include short plain-language guidance explaining that nominal dimensions and limits are design information, that measured results are entered only after inspection, and that an out-of-range measurement belongs in the deviation area.

authoring_plan.gold_construction: Build a clean XLSX with editable cells, borders, text, and drawing lines using openpyxl. Populate only design dimensions and source-supported notes; leave all designated blank fields truly empty. Set page setup, print area, margins, scaling, and sheet visibility explicitly. Render offline to verify one A3 landscape page and compare the render with both archive PDFs. The gold passes when all source dimensions and identifiers are present, the structural regions match the schema, the blank fields contain no values or formulas, and the standalone rendered sheet is readable and period-compatible.

original_instruction:
You are Laila Fitzgerald, the mechanical engineer at Pinehollow Health Network, preparing a replacement-part drawing for a small working print museum that is taking in a 1961 Brennerhoff & Sohn platen press from Cormac Schuyler. The press's impression cam is cracked, and the museum will accept the machine only if the replacement can be documented and filed beside the surviving maker's drawings. Heronbank Terminals is cutting the part for us, so the sheet needs to give a machinist usable dimensions while remaining recognisably consistent with the period archive. Use the two archive drawing sheets in `archive_sheet_01.pdf` and `archive_sheet_02.pdf`, the measured cam and shaft record in `cam_measurements.xlsx`, the museum's acceptance note in `museum_acceptance_note.docx`, and the supplied drawing-sheet reference in `archive_convention_reference.pdf` when preparing the work. Create exactly one file named `replacement_impression_cam_drawing.xlsx` and write it at the top level of the working directory. It will be printed on A3 paper in landscape orientation, placed in a sleeve, and shelved next to the original sheets; keep the drawing readable at that physical size and make the views, dimensions, notes, title information, and first-angle convention agree with the supplied material. The drawing must be a reusable working sheet rather than a completed inspection record: include the part definition and machining information, but leave the measured-result and approval/signature entries empty. The registrar has asked for a clearly bounded place where a later measured value or deviation can be written even when it is longer than the ordinary value, without pushing the surrounding drawing out of alignment, and for short pickup guidance so the next engineer knows what the blank fields mean without the guidance taking over the sheet. Do not add a modern logo, colour branding, extra views, unsupported tolerances, or recommendations about whether the museum should accept the press. Preserve the supplied archive's units, line hierarchy, lettering character, pre-GD&T limit style, and first-angle reading. Keep the workbook functional and easy to inspect, with the drawing sheet as the only printable sheet.

---

The files referred to above are in `references/`:

- `references/archive_sheet_01.pdf` — First surviving Brennerhoff & Sohn archive drawing showing the period sheet convention, view arrangement, lettering, line hierarchy, title-block language, and first-angle projection.
- `references/archive_sheet_02.pdf` — Second surviving archive drawing used to corroborate the historical dimensioning, limit notation, notes-block treatment, and drawing-sheet proportions.
- `references/cam_measurements.xlsx` — Complete and internally consistent measurement record for the cracked cam, mating shaft, keyway, and replacement-part envelope.
- `references/museum_acceptance_note.docx` — Museum filing and acceptance requirements, including the identification wording and the information that must remain blank until inspection.
- `references/archive_convention_reference.pdf` — Reference extract defining the reproducible sheet geometry, projection symbol treatment, line-weight hierarchy, and period lettering and limit conventions to be used when comparing the finished workbook.

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `replacement_impression_cam_drawing.xlsx` — A single-sheet, printable replacement impression-cam detail drawing laid out as an A3 landscape archive-style drawing sheet. (The workbook must contain exactly one worksheet and exactly one printable drawing sheet.; The sheet must print as one A3 landscape page, fitted to one page wide and one page tall.; The drawing geometry, dimensions, notes, title information, and first-angle convention must be derived from the supplied references.; Measured-result and approval/signature fields must remain completely empty.; The sheet must include a bounded expandable deviation or out-of-range-value area and concise pickup guidance.; Do not add logos, colour branding, unsupported tolerances, or recommendations.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
